subject: general
question: In which of the following years was the Third Five Year Plan of India launched?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1961**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Third Five Year Plan **of India was launched in **1961**.
 
• The plan aimed at making India a self-reliant and self-generating economy.
 
• It focused on agriculture and improving the production of wheat, with an emphasis on long-term development.
 
• During this plan, India faced economic challenges due to **conflicts with China in 1962 and Pakistan in 1965**, which impacted its implementation.
 
• The Third Five Year Plan also aimed to address issues related to **poverty, unemployment, and improving living standards**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• India's Five Year Plans were centralized and integrated national economic programs.
 
• The concept was borrowed from the Soviet Union and aimed at planned economic development.
 
• The **First Five Year Plan** was launched in **1951**, focusing primarily on the agricultural sector.
 
• The **Second Five Year Plan (1956-1961)** emphasized industrialization.
 
• Due to the Indo-China war in 1962 and the Indo-Pakistan war in 1965, the Third Five Year Plan could not achieve all its targets and objectives.
 
• After the Third Plan, there was a period of three annual plans before the **Fourth Five Year Plan** was implemented in **1969**.
